NAME                                    READY   STATUS    NODE
etcd-controlplane                      1/1     Running   controlplane

caption: On a self-managed cluster, even the control plane runs as ordinary supervised containers.

code:
# kubelet
#   watches the API server for Pods assigned to THIS node
#   tells the container runtime to start/stop containers
#   reports node health back to the API server
#
# container runtime (containerd)
#   pulls images, runs containers, via the CRI
#
# kube-proxy
#   maintains iptables/IPVS rules so Services reach the right Pods
caption: kubelet + a container runtime + kube-proxy turn a scheduling decision into a running container.
